items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh
items.claim: The LORD commanded Moses to go to Pharaoh

items.quote: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants
items.claim: The LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart and the hearts of his servants

items.quote: that I might shew these my signs before him
items.claim: The LORD would display miraculous signs before Pharaoh

items.quote: what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them
items.claim: The LORD performed miraculous works and signs in Egypt
